requirements.title: Ground every supported answer
requirements.criterion: Documented cases return the exact expected approved facts, with document IDs, versions and literal citations.

requirements.title: Abstain when evidence is missing
requirements.criterion: Unsupported questions return an explicit abstention, no selected facts and no citations.

requirements.title: Keep unapproved context isolated
requirements.criterion: The quarantined attachment never enters retrieval or supplies an accepted answer or citation.

requirements.title: Bind evidence to the exact scope
requirements.criterion: Record all unique cases, source and input hashes, explicit demo approval and execution receipts. Changed inputs or criteria invalidate earlier evidence.

requirements.title: Show an explicit support route
requirements.criterion: Abstentions include the approved demo channel, reserved .invalid URL and reason. No ticket is sent; supported answers do not escalate.
